question: A man refuses to open his window in a stuffy room, panicking at the thought of fresh breezes moving across his face. He has a fear of:

reasons.A: Wrong: fear of heights, not of moving air.
reasons.B: Wrong: fear of enclosed spaces, not of air.
reasons.C: Wrong: fear of open or crowded places.
reasons.D: Correct: aer means air, so the fear is of air.
